extension.description: Reads ScenePass .sp.json sidecars next to video files and skips detected intro and recap segments during playback.
extension.news: v0.01.4 - Closer label-to-arrow spacing (~2-character gap; narrower pill) v0.01.3 - Tighter skip button width (~3-letter gap before arrow); lighter grey background v0.01.2 - Skip overlay: grey pill background, PNG play arrow (fixes skin font/icon glitches) v0.01.1 - Netflix-style Skip Intro / Skip Recap overlay buttons (replaces blocking dialog) v0.01.0 - ScenePass .sp.json consumer - Auto-skip or on-screen prompt for intro and recap - Confidence and minimum-duration gates
